description: A Python script implementing a Streamlit-based chatbot interface that integrates with various language models and a SQL database to handle user queries, especially related to a specific database 'sql_bot'. It sets up environment variables, configures AI models, establishes database connections, defines a prompt template, and manages chat interactions.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: A function that combines a prompt template with a user query, runs it through a language chain, and returns the result while tracking token usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that initializes the Streamlit app, manages chat history, handles user input, and displays responses.
